title: Crew Of Lancaster Aircraft (Serial # MK 442)
memorial_details: description: This record comprises all information held by IWM’s War Memorials Register for this memorial. Where we hold a names list for the memorial, this information will be displayed on the memorial record. Please check back as we are adding more names to the database.
inscription: WELLINGTONIA GIGANTEA/ THIS TREE WAS STRUCK BY LANCASTER MK III 442 V / OF BOMBER COMMAND R.A.F. SHOT DOWN IN FLAMES / BY A JU 188 ON THE NIGHT OF 3/4 MARCH 1945 / THE ENTIRE CREW OF THE LANCASTER PERISHED./ THE CREW COMPRISED/ (NAMES)/ MAY THEY REST IN PEACE
